watchOS 27.2 will be released next month, bringing several new Apple Watch features, and leaker pdfu recently discovered a major change to the screenshot functionality.

The new screenshot experience in watchOS 27.2 code is inspired by the iPhone

Leaker pdfu has recently begun sharing multiple findings from Apple's code. For example, he was the first to discover the "Readiness" app in watchOS 27, and yesterday also leaked the user interface of Siri AI on HomePod.

In a new article today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a redesigned screenshot experience for Apple Watch.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch only causes the screen to flash briefly, after which the screenshot is saved to your Photos library.

The new screenshot process mimics the existing approach on iPhone and iPad, allowing users to choose to instantly share and/or delete the screenshot.

It is currently unclear which beta of watchOS 27.2 Apple plans to include this change in, or whether more development time is needed. However, even if it doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, this feature is likely to come to Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked from watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.
